fnol_text: My name is Maya Oyelaran and I live at 171 Alder Street, Salem, MA 01957. You can reach me on (555) 584-6612 or maya.oyelaran@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 15 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00082. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Oyelaran on (555) 584-6612 to acknowledge the claim. Maya confirmed the loss date as 15 August 2024.
Site visit to 171 Alder Street. Neighbour Dana Osei was present and confirmed the timeline.
Maya sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
